name: What are the essential features of a universally designed bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What are the essential features of a universally designed bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Essential features of a universally designed bathroom aim to make the space functional for everyone, regardless of age or ability. These include a curbless or roll-in shower, ample clear floor space (at least 30x48 inches), grab bars near the toilet and in the shower, a comfort-height toilet, and an accessible vanity with knee clearance. Other important elements are lever-style faucet handles, non-slip flooring, and appropriate lighting. These features combine to create a safe, convenient, and aesthetically pleasing environment for all users.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key features of a universally designed bathroom include a roll-in shower, clear floor space, grab bars, comfort-height toilet, accessible vanity, and lever-style handles. These ensure safety and ease of use for all.
